name: Claude Mem
description: Persistent memory system for Claude Code - seamlessly preserve context across sessions
longDescription: Persists context across Claude Code sessions: **7 lifecycle hook scripts** capture what happened, a Bun worker service compresses it into observations stored in SQLite with FTS5 full-text search, and hybrid search over a Chroma vector database answers natural-language questions about the project's history through search tools. Context from earlier sessions is injected into new ones without being asked. Also installs for the Antigravity CLI and on OpenClaw gateways, with optional cloud sync to cmem.ai. The plugin itself lives in `plugin/` (hooks, skills, `.mcp.json`, a `ui/` viewer) inside a much larger repository. Apache-2.0, version `13.15.0`.
